name: No-Clashing Teaching Dimension
definition: The **No-Clashing Teaching Dimension** is the minimum possible maximum size of the samples in a teacher mapping that assigns one labeled sample to each concept, subject to no two distinct concepts being simultaneously consistent with the union of their assigned samples.
graph_summary: Smallest maximum sample size of a non-clashing teacher mapping.
origin_references: Introduced as the no-clashing teaching dimension in \cite{KSZ2019}.

monotonic.proof: Restricting a no-clashing teacher mapping to a subfamily preserves the no-clashing condition and cannot increase its maximum sample size.

c_monotonic.proof: Restrict a no-clashing teacher mapping to the conditioned fibre and delete fixed coordinates.  A clash in the fibre would already be a clash in the original class.
